drivingQuestion: How may the mishna tell him to hold his member when R' Eliezer likens this to bringing a flood?
outcomeNote: the answer to the objection falls outside this unit

segments.he: הָיָה אוֹכֵל בִּתְרוּמָה וְהִרְגִּישׁ וְכוּ׳. אוֹחֵז? וְהָתַנְיָא: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: כׇּל הָאוֹחֵז בָּאַמָּה וּמַשְׁתִּין, כְּאִילּוּ מֵבִיא מַבּוּל לָעוֹלָם!
segments.en: § The mishna further states that if a priest «was partaking of teruma and sensed» a quaking in his limbs, indicating that a seminal emission was imminent, he should firmly hold his penis to prevent the emission from leaving his body, and swallow the teruma while ritually pure. The Gemara asks: May one «hold» his penis? «But isn’t it taught» in a baraita that «Rabbi Eliezer says: Anyone who holds» his «penis and urinates» is considered «as though he is bringing a deluge to the world,» as masturbation was one of the sins that led to the flood?
